Tooltip_KW_LinkBarrel: Run a rubber hose from the barrel. Fuel will flow down into the generator on its own. <LINE> Petrol in barrel: %1 L
Tooltip_KW_BarrelPetrol: Petrol in barrel: %1 L <LINE> You get the hose back.
Tooltip_KW_BarrelGone: The barrel is gone or holds something other than petrol. <LINE> You get the hose back.
Tooltip_KW_BarrelLow: The barrel stands low: pour fuel by hand with the generator switched off, or put the barrel higher and it runs by itself. <LINE> Petrol in barrel: %1 L <LINE> You get the hose back.
Tooltip_KW_WaterLink: Water from this barrel will run down to every tap of the house on the floors below. <LINE> Water in barrel: %1 L
Tooltip_KW_WaterConnected: Feeds the taps of the house on the floors below. <LINE> Water in barrel: %1 L
Tooltip_KW_Hoist: Take the lid off, pull the barrel up on a rope and connect it to the house water supply. Rain will fill it.
Tooltip_KW_Lower: The water in the barrel is poured out first.
Tooltip_KW_RoofFull: No free spot on the roof within reach.
Tooltip_KW_RoofSummary: Barrels on the roof: %1, water: %2 L
Tooltip_KW_NeedRopeWrench: Requires a rope or a sheet rope, and a pipe wrench.
Tooltip_KW_NeedRope: Requires a rope or a sheet rope.
Tooltip_KW_TapWater: In this tap's pipes: %1 of %2 L
Tooltip_KW_HoistFuel: There is fuel in this barrel. Only water goes into the house supply.
Tooltip_KW_NoBarrel: Put a barrel with petrol next to the generator and connect it with a rubber hose. Higher than the generator (a crate, a table, the floor above) fuel runs on its own; on the ground you pour it by hand.
Tooltip_KW_BarrelOpen: The barrel is open: the fuel evaporates, and out in the open rain will get in and spoil it. Use a barrel with a lid, or close this one.
Tooltip_KW_BarrelSpoiled: Rain or water got into the fuel. The generator won't take it. Empty the barrel. <LINE> You get the hose back.
Tooltip_KW_NoHouseTaps: This house has no taps of its own. Roof barrels feed only the sinks, baths, showers and toilets the house was built with.
Tooltip_KW_StandByWall: Stand outside, no further than two squares from a wall of the house.
Tooltip_KW_LinkLow: Run a rubber hose from the barrel. It stands low, so fuel won't run on its own: pour it by hand into the switched-off generator. Put the barrel higher (a crate, a table, the floor above) and it runs by itself. <LINE> Petrol in barrel: %1 L
Tooltip_KW_PourEmpty: There is no petrol in the barrel.
Tooltip_KW_HoistLinked: This barrel feeds a generator. Disconnect it at the generator first.
